patch_description: Add deterministic geometric variants to every row-layout seed before nonlinear optimization.  The existing random jitter breaks some symmetry, but the row patterns still tend to enter a small number of contact graphs.  Reflecting the indexed configuration can lead SLSQP through a different active-set trajectory, while a small alternating row displacement more directly encourages triangular-lattice contacts and asymmetric boundary defects.  The displacement is far smaller than the initial clearance implied by the low starting radii, so every generated seed remains safely feasible.  This increases basin coverage without changing the public interface or the final feasibility certification.
